description: Apply a role template to one hire (free) or many (Pro), copying the template's tasks into each hire with the template's version recorded. Editing the template afterwards never changes a hire already under way. If no template exists for the role, one is created from the tasks you pass.

hire.description: The hire to apply the template to. Pro: pass a comma-separated list of hire ids or names to apply to many at once

role.description: The role template to apply, by id (T-0001) or role. If omitted, the hire's own role is used

tasks.description: When no template exists for the role, create one from these tasks and apply it. Pro only when applying to more than one hire

name: onboarding_template_apply
title: Apply a role template to a hire
